page_title: HOF 0-3 STU | Hoffenheim v Stuttgart 16/03/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
86' The referee blows his whistle, Hoffenheim are awarded a corner kick.
84' Sebastian Hoeness has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Mahmoud Dahoud (VfB Stuttgart) replacing Serhou Guirassy.
84' It's time for a substitution. Leonidas Stergiou (VfB Stuttgart) comes on in place of Waldemar Anton.
83' Hoffenheim work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
82' Robert Skov (Hoffenheim) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.

82' Maximilian Beier (Hoffenheim) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Hoffenheim.
78' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Pavel Kaderabek trots off the pitch and is replaced by Robert Skov (Hoffenheim).
76' Substitution. Chris Fuhrich walks off the pitch and Silas (VfB Stuttgart) comes on as a substitute.
76' Sebastian Hoeness has decided to substitute Enzo Millot and he is replaced by Woo-Yeong Jeong (VfB Stuttgart).
74' The linesman signals that Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
71' Hoffenheim have been awarded a corner kick.

68' Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) is the lucky recipient of a rebound. He takes advantage of it and fires the ball into the bottom right corner of the target, leaving the goalkeeper completely helpless.
68' Corner kick. Stuttgart will have an opportunity.
67' Here comes a substitution. Anton Stach is given a rest as he is replaced by Finn Ole Becker (Hoffenheim).
67' The referee allows time for a substitution. Ihlas Bebou will be replaced by Marius Bulter (Hoffenheim).
67' The game has come to an end for Wout Weghorst. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim).
67' Stuttgart take a short corner kick.
66' Stuttgart earn a corner.
66' Enzo Millot (VfB Stuttgart) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked.
65' It is time for a substitution. Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) is on for Deniz Undav.
64' A quickly taken corner by Stuttgart.
63' Oliver Baumann pulls off a great save to deny Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick shot towards the middle of the goal.

59' Pavel Kaderabek (Hoffenheim) timed his run perfectly to connect with the resulting corner kick, but his finish from around the penalty spot was rather poor as it went way over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Stuttgart.
59' The ball goes behind for a corner. Hoffenheim will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
58' Wout Weghorst (Hoffenheim) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
55' Umut Tohumcu (Hoffenheim) makes a strong challenge and Sascha Stegemann blows for a foul.
54' Maximilian Beier (Hoffenheim) forces a pass into the box, but Alexander Nubel is alert and does a great job to rob him of the ball.
53' Maximilian Beier (Hoffenheim) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
52' Waldemar Anton (VfB Stuttgart) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
51' The game is interrupted now, Waldemar Anton (VfB Stuttgart) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
49' Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) receives a great pass inside the box and misses a golden chance. The goalkeeper pulls off a stunning save.
48' It looks like Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart) saw red with that tackle. Sascha Stegemann won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
46' A substitution has been made. Kevin Akpoguma goes off and Stanley Nsoki (Hoffenheim) comes on.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+4' Sascha Stegemann blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+3' Sascha Stegemann shows a yellow card to Pavel Kaderabek (Hoffenheim) for his blatant foul.
45+1' 0 - 2 Fantastic team goal! Serhou Guirassy (VfB Stuttgart) was set free in the area by Deniz Undav and fired past Oliver Baumann. 0:2.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
44' David Jurasek (Hoffenheim) had a good opportunity from long range. His shot was directed towards the bottom left corner, but Alexander Nubel was alert and made a comfortable save.
43' Enzo Millot (VfB Stuttgart) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger.
42' Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Sascha Stegemann blows for a foul.
41' Enzo Millot (VfB Stuttgart) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
39' Hiroki Ito (VfB Stuttgart) makes a rough challenge and Sascha Stegemann blows his whistle for a foul.
39' We can have a look at the statistics now, shots on target are 0:6.
38' Josha Vagnoman (VfB Stuttgart) pounces on the rebound on the edge of the box but his wild shot goes high over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Hoffenheim will have a goal kick.
37' Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
35' Kevin Akpoguma (Hoffenheim) was too forceful with his tackle and Sascha Stegemann interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
35' Serhou Guirassy (VfB Stuttgart) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.

33' Waldemar Anton (VfB Stuttgart) attempts to surprise the keeper with a nice shot, but it lacks more accuracy and goes way wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Hoffenheim.
29' Hoffenheim concede a free kick after one of their players holds onto an opposition player.
28' Maximilian Beier (Hoffenheim) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
27' Maximilian Beier (Hoffenheim) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.

27' What a chance that is! Serhou Guirassy (VfB Stuttgart) finds himself unmarked in a promising position after receiving a cross on the edge of the box and his attempt sails a whisker wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Hoffenheim will have a goal kick.
25' Enzo Millot (VfB Stuttgart) latches on to a lofted pass and strikes the ball! His attempt flies narrowly wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Hoffenheim.
23' Fantastic run and shot from mid-range by Ihlas Bebou (Hoffenheim), but a defender denies him an almost certain goal by getting his body in the way.
22' The percentage of ball possession is – 37:63.
21' David Jurasek (Hoffenheim) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
20' Serhou Guirassy (VfB Stuttgart) forces a pass into the box, but Oliver Baumann is alert and does a great job to rob him of the ball.
16' 0 - 1 Goal! Deniz Undav provides Enzo Millot (VfB Stuttgart) with a nice pass inside the box. It allows him to finish with a precise effort into the bottom left corner. 0:1.
15' Great teamplay by Stuttgart as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.

12' Oliver Baumann pulls off a superb save! He leapt to block the shot Hiroki Ito (VfB Stuttgart) fired on target after a rebound. His effort from inside the box flew straight towards the right post, but was stopped by the goalkeeper.
12' Stuttgart quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

12' Enzo Millot (VfB Stuttgart) wastes an opportunity. He finds himself in acres of space and fires in a terrific shot from long range straight towards the roof of the net, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save and stops this one! The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Stuttgart.

10' This was a piece of cake for Oliver Baumann. Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) found himself some space after latching on to a pass, but his strike only went towards the middle of the goal and into the gloves of the prepared keeper.
9' A player from Stuttgart commits a rough challenge. Sascha Stegemann blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.

7' Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) threw away a promising scoring opportunity. He received a fine cross inside the 6-yard box, but his shot missed the target close to the right post. The ball goes out of play and Hoffenheim will have a goal kick.
4' Atakan Karazor (VfB Stuttgart) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety.
4' Neat passing move from Stuttgart in order to create new attacking opportunities.
2' Florian Grillitsch (Hoffenheim) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Sascha Stegemann saw the whole situation.

The players are on the pitch and Stuttgart will have the kick-off.
